tools.name: plan_grocery_order
tools.description: Plans a grocery order from a shopping list as the shopper wrote it, in a covered Canadian city. Use when a shopper asks where their list is cheapest or wants to buy groceries online. Takes the list as text (English or French, quantities included, up to 60 lines), the city or the first three characte

tools.name: get_grocery_catalog
tools.description: Lists GroceryPulse's configured Canadian cities, canonical reference items with their ids, quantity units, known chains and checkout eligibility holds: the ids that compare_grocery_list takes. tools.name: compare_grocery_list
tools.description: Compares current public chain prices for a list of catalogue item ids (from get_grocery_catalog) and quantities in one supported Canadian city; plan_grocery_order is the form that takes a list in the shopper's own words. A lowest-chain recommendation requires fresh full requested coverage at two eli

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_grocery_list · Private data: plan_grocery_order, compare_grocery_list · Public sink: compare_grocery_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_grocery_list · Private data: plan_grocery_order, compare_grocery_list · Public sink: compare_grocery_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_grocery_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
